newsitem.title: JAPAN: Credit Saison jumps in Tokyo on higher rating.
newsitem.headline: Credit Saison jumps in Tokyo on higher rating.

text.p: Shares in Japan's Credit Saison Co Ltd jumped in Tokyo on Wednesday following news that Nomura Securities Co Ltd had upgraded the firm's rating to "1" from a previous "2".
As of 0057 GMT, the shares were up 120 yen at 2,880 yen, making the company the sixth biggest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo bourse. Turnover was 510,800 shares.

In its three-grade rating system, Nomura assigns a "1" rating to issues whose values it expects will outperform the key 225-share Nikkei average by more than 10 percentage points over the following six months.
